desc:
Every golfer has hit a great shot and then wondered which ball was theirs. The Orlivane Personalized Golf Ball Stamp puts your initials or a simple icon on every ball in seconds. The ink is built in: pull off the cap, press the stamp on the ball for 2–3 seconds, and let the mark dry. The compact stamp slips into a bag pocket, and the cap keeps the stamp face clean between rounds.

How to personalize: enter up to 3 letters (or pick a simple icon) in the customization box, and we'll make your stamp to order.

Specifications:
- Package: about 5 × 2 × 5 cm
- Stamp face: 10 mm round
- Weight: about 22 g (0.8 oz) with package
- Ink color: black
- Self-inking (ink built in), reusable

Note: Let the mark dry for a few seconds before handling the ball. Keep the cap on when not in use.
b: MAKE IT YOURS — Personalize your stamp with up to 3 initials or a simple icon. The 10 mm round stamp face is sized for golf balls, so your mark is clear and easy to spot from the fairway.

ONE PRESS, CLEAR MARK — The ink is built into the stamp, so it is ready to use out of the box with no separate ink pad. Hold the ball steady, press for 2–3 seconds, and let the mark dry for a moment before you pocket the ball.
KNOW YOUR BALL ON EVERY HOLE — When everyone in the group plays the same brand, a personal mark ends the "is that mine?" moment. Mark a whole sleeve before your round in under a minute.
POCKET SIZE, BLACK INK — Small enough for a golf bag pocket, and the cap protects the stamp face between rounds.
A GIFT GOLFERS ACTUALLY USE — A practical present for birthdays, Father's Day, Christmas, retirements and golf-trip groups. Each stamp is made to order with your text.
